global_incumbent.interpretation: Comparable cached nested-OOF incumbent, not a private score. This candidate-membership experiment cannot change the incumbent or claim served improvement.

prior_evidence.v2_19: The sole category-AND-core-attribute route never obtained a valid full candidate-recall receipt. Its 20-session activation evidence is local mechanism evidence only and is not reused as an outcome.
prior_evidence.v2_20: Cache implementation d9e04b1 was synthetically verified, but the formal run was blocked before source access by a preregistration conflict.

v2_20b.meaning: One formal process returned target exit code 2 after a valid bootstrap attestation, but the external orchestrator discarded the nested failure receipt. It is neither a resource pass/fail nor an algorithm Go/No-Go and is never rerun or relabeled.

sole_hypothesis.name: CLAUSE_ISOLATED_DUAL_VIEW_RRF_G0
sole_hypothesis.claim: The correct product can be buried when category and positive core attributes must match in one FTS expression. Two field-isolated sparse routes, fused only in the novel tail, can recover orthogonal candidates while preserving the complete variable-C200 prefix.
sole_hypothesis.single_variable: One default-off switch changes no route to one fixed dual-view union. No single-view ablation, route selection, k/limit/slot/term sweep, or result-conditioned rule change is allowed.
sole_hypothesis.strict_novelty_from_v2_19: The old (category AND core_attribute) expression is prohibited from execution and reporting. v2.21 executes category-only and core-attribute-only expressions; it is not a cache-only or orchestration rerun of v2.19/v2.20/v2.20b.
sole_hypothesis.runtime: Target-blind, causal, deterministic, local-only, diagnostic-only, default off.

non_repetition_proof.baseline: Only the sealed complete variable-C200 is the baseline. No v2.19/v2.20/v2.20b trace, result, cache, or terminal receipt may be read or compared.
non_repetition_proof.legacy_source_rule: starter/sparse_multiview.py, scripts/sparse_multiview_candidate_worker.py, the v2.20b runner/bootstrap, and every old result namespace remain blob-identical and are not executable dependencies of the v2.21 worker.
non_repetition_proof.sql_audit: A fake-SQL targeted test must prove that formal G0 executes only category-only and positive-core-only expressions and that the legacy category-AND-core expression execution count is exactly zero.
non_repetition_proof.receipt_fields: Every target-free and candidate receipt reports legacy_route_executions=0 plus aggregate category-route, positive-core-route, and dual-support activation counts; no terms, identifiers, queries, or per-session arrays are emitted.
non_repetition_proof.infrastructure_reuse: Deterministic LRU concepts may be reimplemented as infrastructure, but no old worker, runner, bootstrap, receipt, cached trace, or outcome is invoked or reopened.

visible_state_contract.current_goal_only: Use only status=active records whose version equals visible_context.version. Retired, stale-version, overridden, and withdrawn records are ignored.
visible_state_contract.category_terms: Use canonical category values from build_conversation_constraint_view and only frozen CATEGORIES reverse-registry surfaces mapping back to those values. Unknown/raw category text never enters a route.
visible_state_contract.positive_core_terms: Use polarity=+1 records in exactly material/style/use_case. Canonicalize only through frozen SLOT_VOCABULARIES and use only reverse-registry surfaces mapping back to those values.
visible_state_contract.hardness: Hard and soft positive core values both inform recall. Hardness is preserved separately for the conflict mask and is never inferred from target/outcome.
visible_state_contract.normalization: NFKC/casefold/frozen registry normalization only. No learned synonym, raw latest-turn text, brand inference, price/unit rewrite, embedding, LLM, or catalog-derived post-prereg vocabulary.
visible_state_contract.term_order: Within each route: canonical values and reverse-registry surfaces are normalized, deduplicated, lexicographically sorted, and truncated to 24 terms.

category_only.activation: At least one frozen canonical category value exists.

positive_core_only.activation: At least one active current-version positive material/style/use_case value exists.

frozen_routes.sql: SELECT rowid,parent_asin FROM products WHERE products MATCH ? ORDER BY bm25(products,0.0,6.0,4.0,2.5,2.5,1.5,1.0),parent_asin ASC LIMIT 120

fusion.candidate_scope: Remove every identifier already present anywhere in the complete ordered C200 before fusion. Apply the frozen explicit hard-conflict mask to novel route candidates; an identifier failing the mask receives no fusion score.
fusion.score: Exact Fraction(1,60+rank) summed across supporting routes; rank is one-based within each filtered route. Float arithmetic is prohibited.
tie_break: category route rank ascending with absent=121
positive-core route rank ascending with absent=121
fusion.output: Append fused novel identifiers to the untouched complete variable-C200 prefix and truncate only the novel tail so total length is at most 400.
fusion.prefix_invariant: C200 is a byte-for-byte ordered prefix at every turn. No C200 candidate may be filtered, reordered, duplicated, or lost.
fusion.served_surface: C200[:10] and the first two served pages remain unchanged. This experiment does not call Agent.respond and does not serve the new tail.

hard_conflict_mask.reuse: Reimplement the frozen v2.19 current-goal explicit-conflict semantics inside the new module; the formal worker never imports starter.sparse_multiview. Synthetic conformance tests may import the parent blob 4adf065b0384ab5d45f7bd4582bf7aaf217348a5 only as a test oracle and must prove identical decisions over fixed positive, negative, unknown-metadata, stale-version, retired, and confidence-boundary vectors. The old recall route is never executed.
hard_conflict_mask.unknown_metadata: Keep the candidate. Missing evidence is not a conflict.
hard_conflict_mask.budget: Price/budget is not executed by this G0 mask.

cache_and_determinism.semantics: Fresh cache-disabled direct control, fresh cache-enabled direct worker, and fresh cache-enabled module worker must emit identical complete semantic traces and candidate bytes. Cache may remove repeated computation only.
cache_and_determinism.generation_binding: Bind cache lifetime to exact catalog/SQLite schema, tokenizer, SQL, row/identifier counts, source blobs, and connection total_changes. Any drift clears, closes, and permanently fails the runtime.

post_target_free_evaluator_sources.access: First stat/open/hash/read only after target-free 20/100 is COMPLETE and the candidate-recall claim has been durably consumed, both fresh full-2000 candidate traces are closed/published, and their exact-repeat, ordered-prefix, mask, source, schema, privacy, and resource gates all pass. Target is then attached evaluator-side for membership only and is never a runtime feature.

union expansion turns > 0 and union novel candidate cells > 0
all three traces and full semantic digests are exact
complete C200 ordered-prefix loss/reorder/duplication count is zero
tail duplication and explicit-hard-conflict count are zero
all three cache layers record at least one hit in each cached worker
network attempts=0, GPU bytes=0, exact source/input hashes unchanged
extra route+mask p95 <=100ms and per-turn p95 <=400ms
candidate cells <=2.0 times C200 cells and trace bytes <=2.1 times C200 reference prefix bytes
stage-100 cached direct+module unrounded parent wall math.fsum <=60.0 seconds
target_free_preflight.failure: PRE_OUTCOME_NO_INFORMATION if a route family never activates; otherwise implementation/resource blocker. Neither is an algorithm No-Go. Do not open proxy/labels and do not create a candidate-recall receipt.

candidate_recall_receipt.eligibility: Only after target-free preflight COMPLETE. One full 2000-session same-cohort diagnostic candidate-membership receipt; not a private or independent score.
candidate_recall_receipt.pre_target_trace_protocol: After the immutable candidate claim, run exactly two fresh sequential cache-enabled CPU workers over all 2000 sessions: direct first, literal python -m second. Each streams to its own nonce-scoped partial trace, fsyncs, publishes exclusively, closes SQLite, and emits only a sanitized compact receipt. Before the first proxy/label stat, require byte-identical complete traces and semantic digests, complete ordered-C200 prefix, zero loss/dup/hard-conflict, exact source/input hashes, network=0, GPU=0, peak RSS<=1610612736, each worker wall<=1800 seconds, and total formal parent wall<=1800 seconds. No cache-disabled full worker, third replica, retry, or rerun is allowed.
candidate_recall_receipt.candidate_loss: Structurally zero because C200 is the complete ordered prefix.
candidate_recall_receipt.view_semantics: SEALED_VARIABLE_C200 is the complete per-turn variable-length baseline and remains 1986/2000. EXPANDED_FIXED_K200 may include new tail when the sealed prefix has fewer than 200 candidates and is diagnostic only. C400_COMPLETE_UNION is the primary expanded view.
candidate_recall_receipt.promotion_gate: C400_COMPLETE_UNION recall >=1988/2000, at least two newly recalled targets over SEALED_VARIABLE_C200, gains span at least two outer folds and include at least one non-clothing taxonomy, exact-target-cluster-uniform delta >0, exact repeat and every resource/integrity gate pass, and candidate loss/hard-conflict count remain zero.
candidate_recall_receipt.no_go: A valid complete receipt with C400<=1987 or any distribution gate failure freezes this exact G0. Do not tune k, limits, clauses, slots, terms, or tie-breaks.
candidate_recall_receipt.invalid: Any structural/runtime/source/resource failure is an implementation failure, never algorithm No-Go, and the one-shot is never rerun.
candidate_recall_receipt.forbidden_claim: Candidate recall is not served HR@10, MRR, MTTC, TechnicalScore, private performance, or deployment evidence.

after_candidate_go.action: Create a separate preregistration before any policy outcome. Preserve v2.12 first two pages byte-identical; only intent-age>=3 exploration may consume the new RRF tail with real served-seen exclusion.
after_candidate_go.first_100_policy_gate: net>=1, hit-to-miss=0, MRR delta>=0, MTTC delta<=0, TechnicalScore delta>0, every fold HR/MRR/MTTC non-regression, and exact repeat.
after_candidate_go.global_gate: Any later 2000-session policy candidate must strictly exceed HR@10 0.9910, MRR>=0.695795, MTTC<=2.869, TechnicalScore>0.866858, hit-to-miss=0, and every fold non-regression.

device_selection.reason: SQLite FTS5, branch-heavy conflict masks, exact Fraction RRF, dedupe, and stable append have no frozen semantically equivalent GPU backend. Adding one would introduce another variable.
device_selection.future_policy: For a later dense/encoding mechanism, benchmark the same 100-1000 target-free queries on CPU and an idle local GPU. Select GPU only with no install/download, no process preemption, <=11GB VRAM, no OOM/NaN, identical candidate set/order/hash and exact repeat, and >=1.5x wall speedup.

protected_data_and_git.git_formal_policy: Absolute pinned Git, strict environment without inherited GIT_*, object/control reads only, exact commit/ref/ancestry/blobs, and no status/worktree diff/ls-files/fetch/pathspec traversal.

durable_one_shot_protocol.claim_semantics: Before process start, create the fixed canonical claim with O_EXCL, write/fsync/close it, and fsync the parent where available. A claim exists permanently even after crash. Claim existence with no terminal result is ONE_SHOT_CONSUMED_CRASH and forbids rerun.
durable_one_shot_protocol.outer_capture: After the bootstrap process closes, create the fixed outer file with O_EXCL and write/fsync the exact raw canonical outer envelope, or a sanitized no-envelope failure, before parsing target_exit_code or target_receipt. The v2.20b discard-on-error bug is therefore impossible.
durable_one_shot_protocol.completion: After outer capture, create exactly one canonical COMPLETE or sanitized INVALID_ONE_SHOT_CONSUMED terminal result with O_EXCL/write/fsync/close. Claim, outer, and terminal files are immutable; never truncate, unlink, overwrite, replace, or rerun.
durable_one_shot_protocol.privacy: No identifiers, targets, messages, per-session values, membership vectors, raw traceback, or arrays of length 2000/20000.
